seoTitle: How to Create a Form With Jotform Easily
metaDescription: Learn how to build a professional online form from scratch in Jotform in 2026, from adding fields to customizing themes and publishing your link.
intro: Building a data collection form without writing any code is exactly what Jotform's Form Builder is designed for, whether you're starting completely from scratch or working from a template. This guide covers dragging in core fields, customizing the design theme, and publishing your finished form's sharable link.

steps.heading: Start a new form project
steps.body: Open your Jotform dashboard, click Create Form, and choose to start from scratch.

steps.heading: Add core input fields
steps.body: Use the Form Elements sidebar to drag and drop basic text, email, and phone fields onto your canvas.

steps.heading: Customize the design
steps.body: Launch the Form Designer to adjust colors, themes, and fonts so the form matches your brand.

steps.heading: Configure notifications and thank-you pages
steps.body: Set up email notifications and alerts in Settings, then adjust the success action and thank-you page text.

steps.heading: Publish your form
steps.body: Open the Publish panel to copy your direct public sharing link or grab an embed code for your website.

faq.question: Do I need coding skills to build a form in Jotform?
faq.answer: No, the Form Builder is entirely drag-and-drop, letting you add and configure fields without writing code.

faq.question: Can I customize the form's colors and fonts?
faq.answer: Yes, the Form Designer tool lets you adjust the color palette, theme, and fonts to match your branding.

faq.question: How do I get notified when someone submits my form?
faq.answer: Configure email notifications inside the form's Settings tab so you receive an alert for each new submission.

faq.question: Can I share my finished form without embedding it on a website?
faq.answer: Yes, the Publish panel gives you a direct public link you can share anywhere, in addition to the embed code option.
